description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) 'LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams' used for filtering search parameters related to leave type entitlement usage reports in an HRM system. It includes properties for leave type ID, job title ID, employee numbers, subunit ID, location ID, and inclusion criteria for employees, with methods for getting and setting these properties. It extends a base date range filter and uses traits to include subunit chain functionality.

classes.name: LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Data transfer object for search filter parameters related to leave entitlement usage reports, including filtering options for employee details, leave types, organizational units, and inclusion criteria.
